$description: Karl's button-pilot decisions (DEC-07, 2026-10-26) and the provisional values the pilot uses where the source is silent. Read by scripts/build_button_tokens.py.

rules.colors: Keep the shipped colors (fill = action, white label). Markets where white fails 4.5:1 are a required change in IMPROVEMENTS CLR-04.
rules.radius: Keep each platform's shipped radius as a token: iOS 4 (legacy template 5 + 1 pt border), Android 0.
rules.height: Keep each platform's shipped height as a token. Future change: one height for both (IMPROVEMENTS BTN-01).
rules.font: Core component; label font stays per platform (iOS Open Sans Bold 14 caps, Android system font caps). Future change: one label style (IMPROVEMENTS BTN-02).
rules.android_ui: Android code targets the View-based UI (XML styles and resources).

ios_height.why: Not in the source; Apple minimum touch target (size-touch-min). Confirm with Apps team (MISSING-ASSETS 5.5).

android_label_font.why: Not in the source; Material Components Button default (TextAppearance.MaterialComponents.Button). Confirm (MISSING-ASSETS 5.5).

ios_link_font.why: Not in the source; iOS bodyNormalFont. Confirm (MISSING-ASSETS 5.5).

disabled.why: Android ships these on Your News Continue; iOS has no disabled primary. Used for both apps (Core).

build: Primary: enabled, pressed (native platform feedback), disabled
